g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-404 Wrap labeler for round containers (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: INSPECTION AND TEST PLAN (record results here or in the MES)
Material certs 304 (EN 10204 3.1); UHMW FDA letter; roller cover hardness 70A
Side plates: R, H, U holes bored together (stacked) to the drawing
Roller axes parallel (both plates on the base, tie rod in)
Housing 201 bore Ø28 H7, spigot Ø40 g6; liner drive Ø30 h8, journals Ø12 h6
Drive roller Ø50 matched pair (P1-425 view R)
Rollers turn together, smooth, no tight spot; belt 1 and 2 deflection 3 mm at 10 N
Peel tip: 15 behind container top centre, 1 above, square to the roller axes (S and J)
Unwind drag: roll does not overrun when M1 stops at speed
Liner speed = container surface speed: mark web and container, run 10 labels
Rewind takes up the liner at full roll and empty roll (O-ring slip)
Gap sensor taught on the liner; detects every gap at 150 mm/s, both rolls
Start sensor B2: switches with the arm down on shaker and jar, off with the arm up 10°
Wiring vs E01; PE continuity: stud to -x plate, base, M1 body
Hi-pot / insulation, cord to PE (G1 disconnected)
E-stop stops M1; no restart on release until FEED
Arm lifted mid-label: M1 stops at once
Label placement on 20 shakers and 20 jars: skew, start position, overlap (190 / 255 long)
Rate: 4.3 s cycle, ≥ 14 /min for 10 min (capper rate 14 /min)
Roller covers: Ø check, IPA clean
SETUP TABLE (z above the bench top; fence x from the label centre)
30T → 18T on Ø30: ratio error 0.00 % (any container Ø)
chosen 375-3M-9 (125 T) / 261-3M-9 (87 T); slots take up ± 3
peel 2, idler + rolling 1.0, rewind slip 2 N
ClearPath SDSK 2311: ≈ 0.8 N·m continuous at 115 rpm, 24 V: SF > 10
(idler 15 N + jar weight) x μ 0.6 over the drag: container turns without slip
78.5 mm per motor rev, 800 steps: gap 3 mm = 31 steps
shaker / jar, at 150 mm/s incl. 20 mm run-in
200 OD on a 3 in core, 0.15 web
fuse 3 A T; cord 14 AWG; 24 V 6.5 A supply
bolted to the bench with 4 x M6
